# Contec Healthcare

> > Contec Healthcare provides cleanroom solutions, disinfectant wipes, sterile compounding products, and protective apparel for healthcare facilities, pharmacies, and hazardous drug environments.

Contec Healthcare specializes in USP 797 compliant cleanroom equipment, including TB1-3300 Disinfectant Wipes, PeridoxRTU Sporicide, and Critical Site Sterile Wipes. The site features expert guidance on compounding pharmacy inspections, hazardous drug safety protocols, and ASTM standards for protective apparel.

## Key Topics

- Sterile compounding
- USP 797 compliance
- Cleanroom solutions
- Hazardous drug protection
- Compounding pharmacy
- Disinfectant wipes (TB1-3300)
- PeridoxRTU Sporicide
- ASTM standards
- Chemo gown testing
- IV workflow automation
- Healthcare safety protocols
- Protective apparel
- ASHP conferences
- Cleanroom equipment
- Pharmacy inspections
